title: Improper Neutralization of Input During Web Page Generation ('Cross-site Scripting') vulnerability in Unlimited…
description: A reflected Cross-site Scripting (XSS) vulnerability exists in Unlimited Elements For Elementor (Free Widgets, Addons, Templates) versions up to 2.0.24. This vulnerability allows improper neutralization of input during web page generation, potentially enabling an attacker to execute arbitrary scripts in the context of the affected web application.
